classification: All mechanism numbers are design assumptions/calculations; M05 case facts retain locators. No independent finance admission.
currency: R; R_to_C=1; no fixed bank RUB exchange; certificate5C/RUB is common design scenario.

stacking.special_plus_top: Only separate benefitID or independently proven incremental benefit excluded from ordinary metrics; one benefit one special award.

contests.qualification: Unrounded Q>=1.10 and all prior role QA/exposure bars. Rank floor(100Q+0.5)/100.
contests.team_rule: One group pool and one award per team rank, then predeclared FTE shares sum<=1; failed shares remain unissued.
contests.tie_rule: Equal share of occupied scheduled slots including zeros beyond rank4; final personal floor only; no renormalization.

special.qualification: Implemented benefit used by>=2 colleagues; independent beneficiary confirms actual useful difference;14days no critical/unresolved major; high level>=2 teams/processes.
special.allocation: Fixed slots by independently timestamped readiness within level. Exact timestamp ties share occupied slots. No future promise after exhaustion. One benefitID one award, no upgrade repayment.
special.posting: Ready by month28, independent U recognized month28, posted next month5; prospective work only.
special.nomination: Self-report allowed; recipient never approves own data/level/amount/exception/appeal/posting. Independent owner and separate nonrecipient operator.

rights_calendar.top_window_starts: Cohorts2400 at month1/2/3 day15 then every3months; no retrospective observations.
rights_calendar.gross_unposted_peak_interval: day15..28 before prior top quality/posting;4top+current special
rights_calendar.maximum_does_not_include: Already personal C/R, legacy orders or existing fixed/unposted rights; these remain separately backed.

sku_sensitivity.limit: Linear sensitivity, not a recalculated lot/month cash model. Fixed/old backing unchanged. Full finance check required.

workload.special_verification_timing_limit: 10manager minutes/request includes independent evidence reading, not creation or useful work; validate p95, no assumption actual hours zero.
